title: Emma's Favorite Restaurant
mainIdea: Trying new experiences can help people discover things they may enjoy.

pages.text: Emma and her family loved eating at their favorite Italian restaurant every week.

question.text: Who is one of the main characters?

pages.text: Emma always ordered ravioli, and Josh always ordered spaghetti.

question.text: What did Emma and Josh want?
options: To eat at their favorite restaurant

pages.text: One week, their father suggested trying a new Lebanese restaurant.

question.text: What problem did Emma and Josh face?
options: They had to try a new restaurant they were unsure about

pages.text: Their parents encouraged them to try the new restaurant at least once.

question.text: What did Emma and Josh do?
options: They listened to their parents and agreed to try it

pages.text: Emma and Josh agreed to try the new restaurant and hoped they might enjoy something new.
